1	# WP-006: Knowledge SPA View (`views/knowledge.js`)
     2	
     3	## Plan Context
     4	
     5	Implement the GUI Knowledge Page — 5 REST endpoints, route wiring, SPA view, API client methods, nav link, and CSS — completing the deferred Phase 6 from the Knowledge Accumulation System plan.
     6	
     7	## Description
     8	
     9	Create `gui/public/views/knowledge.js` implementing `renderKnowledge(app)` — the full SPA view with tab bar, filter bars, card rendering, inline editing, delete confirmation, promote, and move interactions.
    10	
    11	## Scope
    12	
    13	- `mcp-server/gui/public/views/knowledge.js` — new file, single `renderKnowledge(app)` function following the `renderInsights(app)` pattern
    14	
    15	## Deliverables
    16	
    17	- State variables: `allInsights`, `activeTab` (`'global'`/`'project'`), `filterCategory`, `filterProject`, `filterQuery`, `editingId`, `confirmDeleteId`
    18	- Tab bar HTML with "Global" and "Repository" buttons (`.knowledge-tabs`, `.knowledge-tab`)
    19	- Per-tab filter bars: Global tab has category dropdown + free-text search; Repository tab has project dropdown + category dropdown + free-text search (both using `.filter-bar` layout)
    20	- `formatConfidence(value)` helper — percentage display with bucket label: 0–33 → `(Low)`, 34–67 → `(Medium)`, 68–100 → `(High)`; bucket thresholds defined as named constants
    21	- `buildKnowledgeHtml(insights)` — card rendering for each insight: scope badge (`.badge-scope-global`/`.badge-scope-project`), category pill (`.category-pill`), tag chips (`.tag-chip`), content preview (first 200 chars + ellipsis), confidence label (`.confidence-label`), source and timestamps, action buttons (Edit, Delete, Promote to Global, Move to Project)
    22	- `applyFilters()` — client-side filter on `allInsights` scoped to active tab's scope value, then by category, project (Repository tab), and free-text query (substring match on title, content, tags)
    23	- `load()` function — calls `API.getKnowledge({})`, passes data to `render()`; no polling
    24	- Inline edit form: title input, content textarea (6 rows), category input, tags input (comma-separated), confidence range slider (min=0, max=1, step=0.01) with live `formatConfidence` display; Save calls `API.updateKnowledge`, Cancel clears `editingId`
    25	- Delete confirmation: first click sets `confirmDeleteId` showing Confirm/Cancel in-place; Confirm calls `API.deleteKnowledge`, removes from `allInsights`, re-renders
    26	- Promote to Global button (project-scoped cards only): calls `API.promoteKnowledge`, replaces insight in `allInsights` by pre-promote id
    27	- Move to Project: inline `<input>` for target slug (`.knowledge-move-input`) with Confirm button; calls `API.moveKnowledge`, replaces insight in `allInsights` by pre-move id
    28	- Tab switching resets `filterCategory`, `filterProject`, `filterQuery`, `editingId`, `confirmDeleteId`, and re-renders
    29	- Event handlers wired via `document.getElementById` or event delegation within `#knowledge-list`
    30	
    31	## Dependencies
    32	
    33	- WP-003
    34	- WP-002
    35	
    36	## Acceptance Criteria
    37	
    38	1. The Knowledge page renders a tab bar ("Global" / "Repository"); switching tabs immediately filters the card list to the corresponding scope without a round-trip
    39	2. Global tab renders a filter bar with category dropdown and free-text search; Repository tab adds a project dropdown
    40	3. Filtering works client-side without a round-trip
    41	4. Each card displays scope badge, category pill, tags, content preview, confidence percentage with bucket label, source, and timestamps
    42	5. Inline editing saves changes via `API.updateKnowledge` and updates the card in-place without a page reload
    43	6. Delete shows an inline confirmation step before removing the card
    44	7. Promote to Global moves a project-scoped card to global scope and re-renders in-place
    45	8. Move to Project accepts a target slug input and re-renders the card with the new scope
    46	9. `formatConfidence` renders `80% (High)`, `50% (Medium)`, `10% (Low)` correctly with bucket thresholds as named constants
    47	10. No `Router._setPolling()` call is made — knowledge is not auto-refreshed
    48	11. Error states are shown via `showError(app, ...)` when API calls fail
    49	
    50	## Active Pipeline Stages
    51	
    52	`implementation` → `qa` → `code-review` → `documentation`
    53	
    54	## Estimated Complexity
    55	
    56	High
    57	
    58	## Rationale
    59	
    60	Inline edit (toggle card → form) rather than navigating to a separate edit page — no other view in the SPA navigates to an entity-edit URL; inline expansion matches the reset modal and config patterns already present. Tab bar gives immediate visual separation of the two knowledge classes (global vs. project-scoped), preferred over a scope dropdown in a unified filter bar or separate routes.
    61	
    62	## Rejected Approaches
    63	
    64	- **Navigate to `/knowledge/:id/edit`:** Rejected because no other view in the SPA uses entity-edit navigation; inline expansion is the established pattern.
    65	- **Scope dropdown in a unified filter bar:** Rejected because it hides the structural distinction between global and project-scoped knowledge.
    66	- **Separate routes (`#/knowledge/global`, `#/knowledge/project`):** Rejected because it adds hash-router complexity for no benefit — both tabs share the same `allInsights` payload loaded once.
    67	- **Delete confirmation via modal overlay:** Rejected because the existing reset modal is the only modal in the codebase managing complex state; inline confirm avoids that complexity for a one-step delete.
    68	- **Confidence as enum label only (Low/Medium/High):** Rejected because a percentage is more informative than a bucket alone; the raw float is too technical for the GUI; percentage + bucket label matches the Synthesis heuristic already documented.
    69	- **Server-driven pagination with prev/next state:** Rejected because knowledge stores are expected to stay small (< 1,000 entries); client-side slice on the full list avoids round-trip complexity; the API already supports `limit`/`offset` for future pagination UI if needed.
    70	
    71	## Notes
    72	
    73	Depends on WP-005 (API client methods) and WP-008 (CSS classes). The `renderKnowledge` function follows the `renderInsights(app)` / `renderConfig(app)` pattern — synchronous HTML build from fetched data, event delegation, no framework. When promoting or moving, the returned insight has a different ID; the view must replace by pre-promote/pre-move id matching, not the new id.
